faq.title: Before you request a demo.
faq.subtitle: The questions nursing home directors, home care leads, and hospital teams ask us most often.

q0.question: What does onboarding look like?
q0.answer: We support the migration of existing records and train the teams on site. The precise timeline is defined after auditing the institution during the demo.

q1.question: How do you integrate with our existing system?
q1.answer: Documented REST API. Synchronization possible via webhooks and CSV/JSON exports. HL7/FHIR integration for hospitals is under study.

q2.question: What if we decide to leave?
q2.answer: Your data is yours. Full export on demand, no fees, in open formats (CSV, JSON). Precise exit terms are defined in the contract.

q3.question: How does pricing work?
q3.answer: Personalized quote issued after a 30-minute demo, based on the size of the institution, the modules chosen, and the number of users.

q4.question: Does our data stay in Switzerland?
q4.answer: Yes. Infrastructure hosted in Switzerland (Infomaniak, Geneva). No patient data leaves Swiss territory. Cantonal adaptations discussed case by case.

q5.question: How do I request a demo?
q5.answer: Request a 30-minute demo via the contact form or by email. We then issue a personalized quote once we've understood your needs.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How CareBond collects, uses and protects your personal data under the nLPD.
privacy.intro: CareBond SA handles your personal data carefully, in compliance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nLPD) and international best practices. This policy describes what we collect on this marketing site, why, and what rights you have.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data collected via carebond.ch is CareBond SA, based in Geneva, Switzerland. For any question about your data, write to us at contact@carebond.ch.

data.heading: 2. Data collected
data.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide via the contact form: full name, professional email address, name of your institution, type of facility (nursing home, home care, hospital, clinic, other) and the content of your message. We do not collect advertising identifiers, nor browser fingerprints. The site contains no third-party tracking cookies.

purposes.heading: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Your data is used exclusively to respond to your demo or information request, schedule a conversation, and where appropriate prepare a personalized quote. We do not use it for automated marketing or profiling.

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Processing of your data is based on your explicit consent (voluntary form submission) and on our legitimate interest in responding to your business inquiry, in accordance with the nLPD.

recipients.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
recipients.body: Your data is accessible only to CareBond SA's internal team. We use two technical processors: (a) Vercel Inc. for site hosting (fra1 region, Frankfurt, EU); (b) Resend Inc. for delivering contact form emails. No other third party receives your data.

transfers.heading: 6. International transfers
transfers.body: Vercel Inc. and Resend Inc. are US-based companies. Data passes through their infrastructure as part of the technical operation of the site and form. These transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and each provider's compliance commitments. Vercel's primary hosting region for this site is in the European Union (Frankfurt).

retention.heading: 7. Retention
retention.body: Messages received via the contact form are kept in our mailbox for as long as needed to process your request, then archived or deleted according to our internal document management practices. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.body: Under the nLPD, you have rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability, objection, and restriction of processing of your data. To exercise these rights, write to us at contact@carebond.ch describing the nature of your request. You may also lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

security.heading: 9. Security
security.body: The site uses TLS 1.3 to encrypt exchanges between your browser and our servers. Form data travels end-to-end encrypted between your device, the Vercel infrastructure, and the final inbox.

cookies.heading: 10. Cookies and trackers
cookies.body: This site currently uses no audience measurement or marketing cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies (for example, language preference) may be set. See our cookie policy for details.

changes.heading: 11. Changes
changes.body: This policy may be updated to reflect technical, legal, or organizational changes. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.

contact.heading: 12. Contact
contact.body: For any question about this policy or about how we process your data, write to us at

problem.heading: In a hospital, time lost finding your way or re-keying data is care lost.
problem.intro: Visitors get lost in corridors. Systems don't talk to each other. Cross-cutting nLPD audits take weeks. And each department has its own tools.

points.p0: Visitors and outpatients wander the corridors, and any reception desk ends up doubling as an info desk.
points.p1: Your current EMR doesn't talk to your scheduling tool, your reports, or your cross-departmental patient record.
points.p2: An nLPD audit means clicking through five different systems to assemble one file.
points.p3: Each service (ER, medicine, radiology) manages its own permissions — no consistency, no unified RBAC.

features.heading: A platform built to integrate, not to replace.
features.intro: CareBond doesn't aim to replace your EMR. We plug in, close the gaps, and add what was missing: indoor wayfinding, multilingual communication, cross-departmental audit.
